description: Request payload for synchronizing plugin routes, group routes and their relationships with the system. When a route in this payload includes `id`, that value is advisory for synchronization and is not the stable identifier to assert after enumeration unless a specific implementation documents preservation. Newly persisted synchronized routes can receive backend-generated, owner-scoped Port OS route IDs; use each route's `associatedPluginRouteId` to match the stable plugin-owned or fixture route identity. Omitted group routes and relationships are not deletion instructions. Every reference must resolve to committed data or to an item in the same request.

authLinkIdentity.description: The ID of the auth link

routes.description: List of routes to synchronize. Route `id` values supplied here are not the stable plugin capability lookup surface after synchronization; match enumerated routes by `associatedPluginRouteId`.

groupRoutes.description: Group routes (maps, rooms, provider groups) to create or update, keyed by `pluginRouteId` within the plugin and auth link.

relationships.description: Typed relationships between the reported routes and group routes.
